title: 持续性眼干口干待查（患者F，42岁）

stages.title: S1 关键信息提取
stages.clinical_information: 患者F，女性，42岁，双眼干涩、异物感，夜间口干需起夜饮水，进食干性食物需用水送服，每天均有，已持续8个月。偶有双手指关节酸痛，无晨僵，伴乏力，无发热。近1年新发龋齿2颗。既往过敏性鼻炎数年。查体：口腔黏膜及舌面干燥，龋齿2颗，双手关节无肿胀、无压痛。
stages.question: 请提取本阶段的关键阳性信息和关键阴性信息，并列出为明确病因还需要进一步询问的病史。

stages.title: S2 初步判断
stages.clinical_information: 追问得知：患者过敏性鼻炎期间间断服用第一代抗组胺药，3个月前已停药，停药后眼干口干无明显改善；目前鼻炎症状轻，仅偶用鼻用糖皮质激素喷剂；月经规律，无其他长期用药。眼科检查：角结膜染色评分（OSS）右眼5分、左眼4分。
stages.question: 请归纳目前的主要临床问题，提出你的初步诊断假设并说明依据，同时指出此时还缺少哪些信息。

stages.title: S3 鉴别诊断
stages.clinical_information: 既往无头颈部放疗史，无结节病、淀粉样变、IgG4相关疾病、移植物抗宿主病病史；抗HCV抗体、HIV抗体阴性；胸片未见肺门淋巴结肿大。空腹血糖、HbA1c、TSH、血常规、肝肾功能、尿常规均正常；ESR 28 mm/h，CRP 3 mg/L，总IgG 17.8 g/L（参考约7-16 g/L），补体C3、C4正常。无腮腺或颌下腺肿痛及持续肿大，无皮疹、光敏感、雷诺现象、口腔溃疡、紫癜，无咳嗽气促及肢体麻木无力。
stages.question: 请列出你的鉴别诊断并按可能性排序，说明每一项在本病例中的支持证据和反对证据，以及排除或区分它所需要的检查。

stages.title: S4 进一步检查
stages.clinical_information: Schirmer Ⅰ试验（无表面麻醉）：右眼3 mm/5 min，左眼4 mm/5 min。ANA 1:160，斑点型；抗SSA/Ro抗体阴性，抗SSB/La抗体阴性（常规检测法）；类风湿因子（RF）弱阳性（28 IU/mL，参考<20）。
stages.question: 请逐项解释上述结果的意义和局限，并说明下一步检查的先后顺序、目的及理由。

stages.title: S5 临床决策
stages.clinical_information: 腮腺超声：双侧腮腺轻度非均匀回声。复诊时患者无紫癜，无腺体持续肿大，无蛋白尿，血常规无减少，无肺部或神经系统症状。患者询问是否需要使用激素或免疫抑制剂。
stages.question: 请给出你目前的综合判断（包括诊断的把握程度及理由）、处理方案和随访计划，并回答患者的提问。

answer_key.internal_title: CASE-A02 持续性干燥症状待查：疑似原发性干燥综合征（未确诊）
answer_key.clinical_intent: 主要考查对持续干燥症状的结构化鉴别、对2016 ACR/EULAR分类标准与临床诊断边界的理解，以及在抗SSA阴性、关键检查尚未完成时的检查优先级与审慎决策；不强求学生写出某个固定的最终病名。

reference_reasoning.entry_condition: 每日持续>3个月的眼干/口干，满足2016标准入口条件；无排除条件（无头颈放疗、抗HCV阴性、HIV阴性、无结节病/淀粉样变/IgG4-RD/GVHD史）。
reference_reasoning.decisive_reasoning: 抗SSA阴性时，无创检查最多再增加唾液流率1分，合计最多3分，仍小于4；达到分类阈值只能通过唇腺活检灶性评分>=1（+3）或抗SSA经复测转为阳性（+3）。因此唇腺活检是决定性检查。
reference_reasoning.classification_vs_diagnosis: 2016标准用于研究分类，不等于临床诊断；未达到4分不等于排除，应补充客观检查与随访；ANA、RF、IgG、ESR及腮腺超声均不是计分条目。

notes: 确认病程、药物与停药时间、既往治疗及系统受累迹象
区分主观症状与客观腺体异常，识别眼表染色与Schirmer异常为客观眼部证据，口干客观证据尚未评估
按2016标准为已知结果计分并识别未评估项，不把未做的唇腺活检或唾液流率当作阳性或阴性
抗SSA阴性不能排除干燥综合征，ANA/RF/IgG不是计分条目
下一步先测非刺激全唾液流率，再考虑唇腺活检（适应证、风险、知情同意、判读要求）
对症与局部管理，无器官受累和明确指征时不启动系统性激素或免疫抑制，并说明其会干扰活检
给出随访时点与危险信号（腺体持续肿大、紫癜、低C4、冷球蛋白、M蛋白、蛋白尿、肺或神经受累）

meta.revision_origin: AI technical/medical DRAFT re-check; not teacher approval
meta.supersedes: r1 draft (git history): stage text leaked the hypothesis and answer hints in questions; HCV exclusion stated as 'known infection' instead of an antibody result; ocular staining unquantified so criteria could not be scored
citations_unverified: 中华医学会风湿病学分会《原发性干燥综合征诊疗规范》中华内科杂志2020;59(4):269-276 (UNVERIFIED)

rubric.scale: Each dimension rated 0-100, weights sum to 100; weights and anchors are pending authentic clinical teacher validation. Training rubric weights (20/20/20/15/15/10) are a separate scale and are untouched.

medical_knowledge.high: Lists the five 2016 ACR/EULAR items with weights (3/3/1/1/1, threshold 4), the entry and exclusion conditions, notes that ANA/RF/IgG/ultrasound are not scored items, and states that classification criteria are not a clinical diagnosis.
medical_knowledge.mid: Knows the criteria exist and some items, but omits weights or exclusion conditions, or blurs classification and diagnosis.
medical_knowledge.low: Cannot name the criteria, or treats dryness symptoms or a positive ANA/RF as diagnostic.

key_information.high: At least 4 key positives (8-month daily course, no improvement 3 months after stopping the antihistamine, abnormal ocular staining, Schirmer 3/4 mm, new caries, hand joint aches without synovitis) and at least 4 key negatives (no radiation, HCV/HIV negative, no gland swelling, no purpura, no proteinuria), and explains what the 3-month washout and the negative anti-SSA mean.
key_information.mid: Extracts most positives but few negatives, or does not interpret the washout or the negative anti-SSA.
key_information.low: Restates the case without selecting key points, or misses the medication history entirely.

differential_diagnosis.high: At least 6 differentials covering medication effect, other dry-eye types, metabolic/endocrine causes, infection or infiltrative disease, secondary Sjogren (with SLE/RA), and lymphoproliferative disease, each with case-specific supporting and opposing evidence and the test needed to exclude it.
differential_diagnosis.mid: Several correctly ranked differentials but evidence is generic, or the exclusion tests are missing.
differential_diagnosis.low: Names primary Sjogren only, or a bare list of diagnoses without case-level evidence.

evidence_integration.high: Scores the known results (Schirmer 1 + ocular staining 1 + anti-SSA 0 = 2, below 4), marks salivary flow and labial biopsy as not assessed, explains that non-invasive testing can reach at most 3 points so biopsy or repeat serology is needed, and that a negative anti-SSA does not exclude disease.
evidence_integration.mid: Recognises the score is below threshold but cannot show the item-by-item arithmetic or the unassessed items.
evidence_integration.low: Concludes a definite diagnosis from symptoms or ANA/RF, or excludes disease because anti-SSA is negative, or treats the unperformed biopsy as a result.

clinical_decision.high: Prioritises salivary flow then labial gland biopsy (indication, consent, timing before any steroid), gives topical and symptomatic management, does not start systemic immunosuppression, and names a follow-up interval with escalation triggers.
clinical_decision.mid: Reasonable tests and symptomatic care but no priority order, no follow-up interval, or vague about immunosuppression.
clinical_decision.low: Starts steroids or immunosuppressants without indication, orders an undirected battery of tests, or gives no plan.

evidence_based_medicine.high: Cites the 2016 ACR/EULAR criteria and the EULAR 2020 management recommendations, states biopsy risks, avoids unindicated immunosuppression, and names lymphoma-risk markers to monitor (persistent gland swelling, purpura, low C4, cryoglobulin, M protein).
evidence_based_medicine.mid: Mentions guidelines in general terms or covers only some safety points.
evidence_based_medicine.low: No evidence basis, or recommends unsafe or unindicated treatment.

rubric.weights_note: Same values as `dimensions`; `weights` is the key POST /api/assessments/forms reads. Without it the form silently falls back to the study defaults.
